features.title: Catalog and search
features.description: Nested categories with product counts, relevance-ranked search over names and descriptions, and additive price, rating and stock filters with URL-encoded state.

features.title: Cart and checkout
features.description: Variant-keyed cart with stock-capped quantities, guest carts that merge on login taking the higher quantity, and an authenticated checkout that validates stock before writing an order.

features.title: Customer accounts
features.description: Registration with password strength feedback, lockout after five failed logins in fifteen minutes, single-use hourly password resets, and an account area with addresses, wishlist and order history.
